data: What is the accuracy of the line with circle markers in the Amazon dataset when λ is 0.2?

The question asks for the accuracy of the line with circle markers in the Amazon dataset when λ is 0.2. From the caption, we know that the line with circle markers represents the Kitchen dataset. In the graph, the line representing the Kitchen dataset intersects with the line representing the Book dataset at approximately 90% accuracy when λ is 0.2. Therefore, the accuracy of the line with circle markers in the Amazon dataset when λ is 0.2 is approximately 90%.
